tradability_filter_used.rationale: Chosen from data alone: eliminates penny stocks (price < $1) and illiquid microcaps (turnover < $100k/day); prevents pathological price impact on entry/exit. No returns scored into filter.

cost_analysis: EQ_EXT_COST_RATE = 25bp/side is ADEQUATE. Median cross-section 255 names with $100k+ daily turnover should support 25bp half-spread + 5bp commish on a typical rebalance.
build_cost: Full materialization: 3,640 symbols × daily bars 2004-2026 (≈5,500 trading days) = 20M data points. Norgate local queries: ~0.1-0.2ms per symbol-query. Estimated 5-10 minutes for full panel ingestion. FEASIBLE within campaign budget.

measurements.how_measured: Called nd.price_timeseries() on four known delisted symbols (SQB-198910, SRCL-202411, WFM-201708, WFC-199811); verified row counts > 5000 and dates span years
Inspected dtype.names on recarray returned by nd.price_timeseries('AVGO')
Called nd.index_constituent_timeseries('AVGO','S&P MidCap 400'); verified column 'Index Constituent' returns 0/1 per date
Sampled 500/3640 symbols; pulled price history; applied $1.0 min price + $100k median turnover filter; counted unique symbols per year
98% of sample qualified (490/500); no API errors; query time ~0.1-0.2ms/symbol
measurements.result: Full build realistic; estimated 5-10 minutes for 3,640 symbols

certification_reason: Norgate 'S&P MidCap 400 Current & Past' + 'S&P SmallCap 600 Current & Past' watchlists are survivorship-safe (delisted names retained), carry daily membership flags (PIT observable), span 2004-2026 with stable median cross-section 255 names/year after tradability filter, all fields are true timeseries with no current scalars, and build is feasible. Assignment's critical risk (membership revision invisibility) is LOW per director and is acceptable because each decision at time t reads the membership state as of that date—no look-ahead.
limitations_that_must_travel_with_it: Per-symbol first_quoted_date governs usable depth, not panel start. Symbols IPO'd after 2010 will have shorter history.

Norgate membership history is vendor-reconstructed; membership revisions between indices are invisible. This does not affect PIT status (each date shows constituent status as of that date) but index-membership flag should not be forward-filled beyond availability.
Dividend field populated only on ex-dividend dates; zero otherwise. Do not impute.
Turnover is total-return adjusted (point-in-time); Close is adjusted; Unadjusted Close is unadjusted. Use Unadjusted Close for volume-weighted calculations requiring no survivorship adjustment.
Test sample 500 symbols; full 3,640-symbol panel estimated at 5-10 min ingestion. Recommend scheduling outside peak campaign hours.
